title: Dormant directory refresh re-advertises a datastore endpoint as the live rate service
fault_primitive: Detached in-container directory synchronizer repeatedly overwrites existing Consul rate registrations after a four-minute stabilization interval
incident_class: An abandoned operational inventory reconciliation process retains write authority after an address-source migration
symptoms: Hotel searches return HTTP 500 with search dependency unavailable; search logs surge with downstream request failed and gRPC Unavailable, while all application pods and Kubernetes Services remain healthy and direct rate connections remain usable.
